title: Grain Marketing Contracts: Pricing Facilities, Increments and Daily Cutoffs
content:
What a member may fix, in what parcels, through which channel and by what hour of the day is fixed by the marketing programme their contract is written on. The table below is the pricing side of the Grain Marketing Contracts catalogue.

| Programme | Basis may be fixed separately | Futures may be fixed separately | Bushels may be carried unpriced | Smallest parcel one instruction may price (bushels) | Instructions worked for one member in one trading day | Member may price in the online portal | Daily cutoff, elevator local time |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Spot Cash Delivery Ticket | No | No | No | 0 | 0 | No | 14:15 |
| Forward Cash Sale Contract | No | No | No | 0 | 0 | No | 13:45 |
| Basis Fixed Contract | Yes | No | Yes | 1000 | 3 | No | 13:15 |
| Hedge-to-Arrive Contract | Yes | Yes | Yes | 5000 | 4 | Yes | 13:15 |
| Delayed Price Agreement | Yes | Yes | Yes | 500 | 2 | Yes | 13:15 |
| Minimum Price Contract | Yes | Yes | Yes | 5000 | 2 | No | 13:00 |
| Managed Accumulator Program | Yes | Yes | Yes | 10000 | 6 | Yes | 12:45 |

## The same terms as conditions of the programme

A programme whose column for carrying bushels unpriced reads No admits no parcel into the unpriced position at all. A programme whose portal column reads No is priced at the desk however the portal behaves for the member. The daily cutoff is a time of day read on the elevator's local clock, and the smallest parcel is the least bushels one instruction may name.

## Points of judgement

An instruction for 500 bushels is at the smallest parcel the Delayed Price Agreement will work, and is therefore worked; the same instruction on a Basis Fixed Contract falls short of that programme's 1,000 bushels. A member on the Managed Accumulator Program may lodge as many as 6 instructions in a trading day, and the desk works them up to that count.
